title: Granite Ridge Pass Account Schedule: Retry, Late Fee, Tolerance and Restoration Figures
content:
## Figures the pass account carries when a scheduled instalment is refused

For every tier of the Granite Ridge Season Pass Programme the collective publishes six figures that bear on a pass account whose scheduled instalment has been refused: the number of calendar days after a refusal before the same instalment is presented again, the fee placed on the pass account for an instalment refused and left unsettled, the number of calendar days of grace after a refusal, the number of refusals in the rolling review window that brings the pass into suspension review, the number of calendar days a balance may stand past due before scanning privileges are withdrawn, and the fee placed on the pass account when a suspended pass is brought back into good standing.

| Tier | Retry interval (calendar days) | Late fee (USD) | Grace period (calendar days) | Refusals tolerated | Arrears period (calendar days) | Reinstatement fee (USD) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Granite Ridge Four-Day Flex Pass | 4 | 25.00 | 5 | 2 | 21 | 45.00 |
| Granite Ridge Midweek Pass | 4 | 25.00 | 5 | 2 | 21 | 45.00 |
| Granite Ridge Local Pass | 4 | 25.00 | 5 | 3 | 28 | 45.00 |
| Granite Ridge Summit Pass | 5 | 29.00 | 7 | 3 | 28 | 49.00 |
| Granite Ridge Summit Plus Pass | 5 | 29.00 | 7 | 3 | 30 | 49.00 |
| Granite Ridge Collective Unlimited Pass | 5 | 35.00 | 10 | 4 | 35 | 55.00 |
| Granite Ridge Collective Elite Pass | 7 | 35.00 | 14 | 4 | 45 | 0.00 |

### Notes on the figures

The retry interval and the grace period are distinct figures counted from the same day, the day the instalment was refused, and on every tier the grace period is the longer of the two.

The tolerance column is a count of refusals, not an amount of money, and it rises with the tier from 2 on the Granite Ridge Four-Day Flex Pass and the Granite Ridge Midweek Pass to 4 on the two collective tiers.

The Granite Ridge Collective Elite Pass carries a reinstatement fee of 0.00, the only tier in the programme published at that figure.
